summary: THE Room is unchanged in geometry and materials since w19: 09c_room.js and the room SEATMAT keys are untouched, and the room-only box means move by 3 L or less in every view. The visible differences come from other areas. (1) Lighting: the cove rim lobe is now gated to aft of THE Room (rimZ in 04_shaders.js), so the beaded white glints along the cap and divider rails are gone. The broad rolled highlight strip on the rails stays (q09 rail rows p90 220/191/185 -> 220/190/185; pixels > L200 in the rail rows 27/4/12 -> 26/1/9; rail high-pass std 18.7 -> 16.5). This is a small gain against the matte caps of c_27314, not a loss. (2) Sidewall and windows: the window belt is cooler and less bright (q08 window box RGB 216/219/223 -> 200/209/222; q06 sidewall 227/228/231 -> 222/225/234), which slightly lowers the share of pixels > L200 in every view. (3) Monuments: the door-3 bar background in q07 is now the in-service face. None of these touches room proportion, colour or detail, and no new artefact appears: there is no z-fighting, gap, float or moire in the 2x crops of the near caps, the aisle end and the far rows. The product still reads clearly as THE Room with minor material and lighting differences. Holds 8.5 with no high or medium issues.
